question: What worldly analogy explains the need to guard a blissful inner attainment?
premises: In the world, a happiness-giving thing is concealed.
The same principle applies to the ritual context.
inference: Just as a happiness-giving thing is concealed in the world, so should the attained state be guarded.
plain_english: Just as a happiness-giving thing in the world is to be concealed, so it is here.
